paths.head: CTV · view-through to pre-order
steps: Ad plays on the TV. Household IP is logged
Someone in the home scans the QR or searches the store
Pre-order page visited, Sabio pixel fires
Visit matched to the impression, read against the holdout

paths.head: Mobile · click-through to install
steps: Ad plays on the phone and is tapped. Device ID logged
Call of Duty app installs and opens
MMP matches the device ID to the click. Install counted

slides.side:
Q4 is when shooter launches are won or lost, and the conquest pool is on phones every day.

We think a four-week read on rival shooter players is the fastest way to show what the graph adds to the launch plan.

slides.title: Privacy and data considerations
slides.kicker: What we see, what we don't, and what stays put
slides.footnote: Source: Sabio Internal FAQ and CTV FAQ, 2026. Data management documentation available on request.

cells.head: What we observe
cells.body: Which apps are installed and how recently they're used. Never in-game activity or anything a player types.

cells.head: Age
cells.body: Adult audiences only, 18+. Mature-rated creative runs only on age-appropriate inventory.

cells.head: What leaves Sabio
cells.body: No device IDs. Reporting is aggregated by age, demo and geo. Exposure files can go to your MMP.

cells.head: iOS signal
cells.body: Apple's restrictions mean most app data comes from Android. We show the iOS share on the build.

cells.head: Activision 1P
cells.body: Player lists can be layered in or suppressed via LiveRamp or a clean room, on Activision's terms.

cells.head: Brand safety
cells.body: DoubleVerify on all supply, TAG registered, US only. Block and allow lists accepted.
